definitions.explanation: The surface of the earth that one walks on.

examples.japanese: {地面|じめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{地面|じめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濡|ぬ}れている→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧。
examples.english: The ground is wet from the rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{地面|じめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れた→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。
examples.english: The ground shook from the earthquake.

notes:
{地面|じめん} refers to the surface of the earth or ground.

Common collocations:
- {地面|じめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (to fall to the ground)
- {地面|じめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧ (to sit on the ground)
- {地面|じめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れる→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧ (the ground shakes)
- {地面|じめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧ (to dig the ground)
- ⟦{濡|ぬ}れた→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧{地面|じめん} (wet ground)

Related words:
- ⟦{地|じ}→地：noentry⟧/⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧ (earth, soil)
- ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧ (floor - indoors)
- ⟦{大地|だいち}→大地：12187_daichi⟧ (the earth, the ground - more poetic)
- ⟦{地表|ちひょう}→地表：18419_chihyou⟧ (earth's surface - scientific)
